claims.summary: Let C be a smooth integral curve over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, T a rational function with a double pole at P, and U an N-dimensional constant-field space of rational functions with pole order at most p>=0 at P. If N>2p+1, all three divided-derivative determinants on columns {0,...,N-1}, {0,...,N-2,N}, and {0,...,N-2,N+1} are nonzero rational functions.
claims.assessment: Working proof: an adapted local basis has distinct half-integral T-exponents with negative sum; the two skipped-column factorial-Vandermonde coefficients are nonzero by explicit polynomial remainders. This is a sufficient pole bound, not a criterion at every fixed mark or in positive characteristic.
claims.rationale: Supplies the needed companion-minor nonvanishing for the actual four-conic limit without assuming ordinary jets imply it; no external novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Use the retained leading coefficients, rather than determinant orders alone, to study the local polar intersection.

claims.summary: For dimension four over every characteristic-zero field and every d>=2, each primitive Taylor form F=Delta/u, m1=M_(N-1)/u, and k=K/u has exact order d(d-1) at the generic point of each of the fifteen two-pair collision strata, with N=8d-4 and u=c(e4 V)^[d^2+(d-1)^2].
claims.assessment: Working proof by the exact four-conic section-lattice index, the bounded-pole skipped-minor lemma in every distinguished-coordinate frame, and moving-mark transport. This proves only the order part of conj:cube-two-pair-order; tangent-cone factors, triple-stratum nonvanishing, colon lengths and first-step thresholds remain open.
claims.rationale: Completes the uniform local-order assertion for all three forms entering the first-step Taylor colon. Further leading-form data are required for the goal; no top-level threshold is settled.
claims.next_action: Determine common factors of the three leading forms on the exceptional line, starting with the endpoint factor predicted by the tangent-cone conjecture.

relationships: Uses nonvanishing of the two skipped-column determinants at a generic moving mark.
Uses the exact focused-lattice index 5d(d-1)+2 and independent restriction to the marked conic.
Uses the local lower bound for all three primitive forms at every stratum.
Uses the common collision valuation and exact moving-mark row transport.
Uses the homogeneous coordinate permutation behind the group action; does not infer companion nonvanishing from triangular mixing.
Proves the three exact orders, leaving tangent-cone factorization and the triple-stratum assertion open.
The earlier falling-factorial Vandermonde computation is reused algebraically; the pole bound and skipped-column coefficients are derived here.

conj:cube-two-pair-order.mathematical_status: The exact-order assertion for all three forms is now proved in characteristic zero. Tangent-cone factors and triple-stratum nonvanishing are still conjectural.

conj:cube-two-pair-order.assessment: Conjecture, partially proved. The exact order d(d-1) of F,m1,k at every two-pair stratum is proved in characteristic zero for every d>=2 by thm:cube-two-pair-minor-orders. The asserted tangent-cone factors and the triple-stratum assertion remain open; retained modular d=2,3,4 data support those parts only.
